gloss: on'yomi and kun'yomi; Chinese and Japanese readings

definitions.gloss: on'yomi and kun'yomi; Chinese and Japanese kanji readings
definitions.explanation: The two types of readings for kanji characters: the on'yomi (Sino-Japanese reading derived from Chinese pronunciation) and the kun'yomi (native Japanese reading).

examples.japanese: ⟦{漢字|かんじ}→漢字：09480_kanji⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{音訓|おんくん}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{覚|おぼ}える→覚える：00739_oboeru⟧。
examples.english: I memorize the on and kun readings of kanji.

examples.japanese: ⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧⟦{漢字|かんじ}→漢字：09480_kanji⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧いくつ⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{音訓|おんくん}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦あります→ある：00006_aru⟧⟦か→か：09473_ka⟧。
examples.english: How many on and kun readings does this kanji have?

examples.japanese: ⟦{常用漢字|じょうようかんじ}→常用漢字：20778_jouyoukanji⟧⟦{表|ひょう}→表：19354_hyou⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{各|かく}→各〜：00449_kaku⟧⟦{漢字|かんじ}→漢字：09480_kanji⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{音訓|おんくん}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{示|しめ}されている→示す：01948_shimesu⟧。
examples.english: The Jouyou Kanji chart shows the on and kun readings for each kanji.

notes:
{音訓|おんくん} is a compound of {音|おん} (sound; on'yomi) + {訓|くん} (reading; kun'yomi). It is an essential term for anyone studying Japanese writing.

⟦{音読|おんよ}み→音読み：10453_onyomi⟧ (on'yomi) is the reading derived from the original Chinese pronunciation, typically used in compound words (⟦{熟語|じゅくご}→熟語：04219_jukugo⟧). ⟦{訓読|くんよ}み→訓読み：10454_kunyomi⟧ (kun'yomi) is the native Japanese reading, often used when the kanji stands alone or with okurigana.

EXAMPLE:
The kanji ⟦{山|やま}→山：02168_yama⟧ has the on'yomi サン (as in ⟦{山脈|さんみゃく}→山脈：07856_sanmyaku⟧, mountain range) and the kun'yomi やま (as in ⟦{山|やま}→山：02168_yama⟧, mountain).

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {音訓|おんくん}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{調|しら}べる→調べる：01213_shiraberu⟧: look up the on and kun readings
- {音訓|おんくん}⟦{索引|さくいん}→索引：04168_sakuin⟧: on/kun reading index
- {音訓|おんくん}⟦{表|ひょう}→表：19354_hyou⟧: table of on and kun readings

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{音読|おんよ}み→音読み：10453_onyomi⟧: on'yomi — the Chinese-derived reading alone
- ⟦{訓読|くんよ}み→訓読み：10454_kunyomi⟧: kun'yomi — the native Japanese reading alone
- ⟦{読|よ}み{方|かた}→読み方：14269_yomikata⟧: way of reading — a more general term for how to read something
